name: A312-1-an-unfinished-upload-reads-as-a-backup
old: if (card && (card.bytes ?? 0) > 0) return { state: 'saved', when: agoText(card.updatedAt, nowS), error: null };
new: if (card) return { state: 'saved', when: agoText(card.updatedAt, nowS), error: null };
note: `bytes` stays 0 until the data lands, on purpose - the service keeps a half-finished upload visible rather than letting it pass for a backup. This mutant SURVIVED the whole suite before the audit, because the decision lived in ui/enhancedMenu.js where no node pin could reach it.

name: A312-2-a-legacy-card-is-silently-off
old: if (!characterId) return { state: 'wait', when: null, error: 'no-character' };
new: if (!characterId) return { state: 'off', when: null, error: null };
note: AUDIT-312 F2, restored: the tile fell to `off` for a card written before CHARID1, so the sentence the refusal table has always had for it could never be shown - a tile with no cloud line and no reason, beside tiles that have one.

name: A312-3-a-stale-refusal-outlives-the-retry-it-caused
old:
if (busy) return { state: 'busy', when: null, error: null };
  if (error) return { state: 'bad', when: null, error };
new:
if (error) return { state: 'bad', when: null, error };
  if (busy) return { state: 'busy', when: null, error: null };
note: Press Try again and the tile still reads as failed while the retry is in flight - so the player presses it again, and again.

name: A312-4-two-characters-share-one-slot-key
note: Every character's QuickSave becomes one slot: one spinner, one error and one armed Delete on all of them. SURVIVED the whole suite before the audit, in the menu's own copy of this line.

name: A312-5-the-listing-is-patched-rather-than-asked
note: The latch is still set, so a push that lands never changes what the tile says the cloud holds until the menu is closed and reopened.

name: A312-6-the-cloud-latch-outlives-the-visit
note: Module state, so `once per visit` was really once per page load: a player who backed a save up on another device and reopened this menu was shown the listing from whenever it was last asked.

name: A312-7-the-delete-does-not-ask-twice
note: The one button in this menu that destroys something, one mis-press from a backup that is gone - beside `Back up again`, which is the button next to it.

name: A312-8-the-delete-takes-the-local-save-too
old:
export const removeCloudSlot = (io, { characterId, saveName }) =>
  ask(io, slotPath(characterId, saveName), { method: 'DELETE' });
new:
export const removeCloudSlot = (io, { characterId, saveName }) =>
  ask(io, slotPath(characterId, saveName), { method: 'DELETE' }).then((r) => { io.storage?.removeItem?.(`x${characterId}`); return r; });
note: The cloud is the COPY. Deleting a backup that also deleted the game is the single worst thing this arc could do, and the design record says so twice.

name: A312-9-the-ten-heads-are-compacted
old:
for (let i = 0; i < races.FACES_PER_RACE; i++) set.push(bitmapCanvas(cif.getDFBitmap(i, 0), palette.rgb, { scale }));
    return set;
new:
for (let i = 0; i < races.FACES_PER_RACE; i++) set.push(bitmapCanvas(cif.getDFBitmap(i, 0), palette.rgb, { scale }));
    return set.filter(Boolean);
note: This is what the extraction shipped. `faceIndex` addresses a RECORD NUMBER, and `bitmapCanvas` returns null for a record it cannot draw - so one bad record shifts every later face down by one, while ui/chargenArt.js's loadFaceSet, reading the same ten records, never compacts.

name: A312-10-the-player-half-of-the-R2-key-is-pasted-unencoded
why: A player id is minted by the service itself - accounts.js mintId, base64url, so [A-Za-z0-9_-] and encodeURIComponent is a no-op over every id that can exist. It is belt for the day an id's alphabet changes, not a branch, and the audit DROVE that rather than assuming it.
